meta.title: Lao Alphabet
meta.subtitle: 79 letters, vowels, tone marks and digits · both directions, as two cards each
meta.desc: The Lao script: 79 notes, in the order a Lao primer teaches it — the 27 consonants in their traditional order, the six ligatures of a silent ຫ, the vowels, the four tone marks and two other signs, the three consonant classes that decide a syllable's tone, and the ten Lao digits. The first deck of the Lao collection. Both directions: see a letter and recall its sound, or see a sound and recall the letter, each a card with its own schedule. Every consonant is given with its NAME — Lao letters are named by a word that starts with them (ກ ໄກ່, k as in chicken) — and the name is how the letters that sound alike are told apart, so the sound side names it too: ຂ and ຄ both say kh, ສ and ຊ both say s. Each consonant shows its CLASS, high, middle or low, which together with the tone marks and the length of the vowel decides the tone of every syllable, and its sound at the start and at the end of a syllable (ບ is b at the start and p at the end). Each vowel is written on ◌, the dotted circle standing for the consonant it sits on, since a Lao vowel can be written above, below, before or after its consonant, and several change shape inside a closed syllable. The sounds are described in English words — approximations, as every learner's alphabet gives them — with one everyday word that shows each, romanised as in the level decks, and a speaker beside the letter and the word. Sources: English Wikipedia's 'Lao script' (the consonants, ligatures, vowels and digits) and 'Lao language' (the tone rules), read 2026-11-15 (CC BY-SA 4.0); the example words' pronunciations are English Wiktionary's, via the kaikki.org extraction (CC BY-SA 4.0).

fields.Name: ກ ໄກ່
fields.Sound:
ໄກ່ · “chicken”middle class
k with no puff of breath, as in skin; at the end of a syllable: k

fields.Name: ຂ ໄຂ່
fields.Sound:
ໄຂ່ · “egg”high class
kh, a k with a puff of breath, as in kit; never ends a syllable

fields.Name: ຄ ຄວາຍ
fields.Sound:
ຄວາຍ · “water buffalo”low class
kh, a k with a puff of breath, as in kit; never ends a syllable
fields.Example: ຄວາຍkhuai˧˥water buffalo

fields.Name: ງ ງົວ
fields.Sound:
ງົວ · “ox”low class
ng, as in sing — also at the start of a syllable; at the end of a syllable: ng

fields.Name: ຈ ຈອກ
fields.Sound:
ຈອກ · “glass”middle class
ch with no puff of breath, between the ch of church and the j of jam; never ends a syllable

fields.Name: ສ ເສືອ
fields.Sound:
ເສືອ · “tiger”high class
s, as in sun; never ends a syllable

fields.Name: ຊ ຊ້າງ
fields.Sound:
ຊ້າງ · “elephant”low class
s, as in sun; never ends a syllable

fields.Name: ຍ ຍຸງ
fields.Sound:
ຍຸງ · “mosquito”low class
ny, as in canyon; at the end of a syllable: i (a y glide)

fields.Name: ດ ເດັກ
fields.Sound:
ເດັກ · “child”middle class
d, as in day; at the end of a syllable: t

fields.Name: ຕ ຕາ
fields.Sound:
ຕາ · “eye”middle class
t with no puff of breath, as in stop; never ends a syllable

fields.Name: ຖ ຖົງ
fields.Sound:
ຖົງ · “bag”high class
th, a t with a puff of breath, as in top (never the th of thin); never ends a syllable

fields.Name: ທ ທຸງ
fields.Sound:
ທຸງ · “flag”low class
th, a t with a puff of breath, as in top (never the th of thin); never ends a syllable

fields.Name: ນ ນົກ
fields.Sound:
ນົກ · “bird”low class
n, as in no; at the end of a syllable: n

fields.Name: ບ ແບ້
fields.Sound:
ແບ້ · “goat”middle class
b, as in boy; at the end of a syllable: p

fields.Name: ປ ປາ
fields.Sound:
ປາ · “fish”middle class
p with no puff of breath, as in spin; never ends a syllable

fields.Name: ຜ ເຜິ້ງ
fields.Sound:
ເຜິ້ງ · “bee”high class
ph, a p with a puff of breath, as in pin (never the f of phone); never ends a syllable

fields.Name: ຝ ຝົນ
fields.Sound:
ຝົນ · “rain”high class
f, as in fan; never ends a syllable

fields.Name: ພ ພູ
fields.Sound:
ພູ · “mountain”low class
ph, a p with a puff of breath, as in pin (never the f of phone); never ends a syllable

fields.Name: ຟ ໄຟ
fields.Sound:
ໄຟ · “fire”low class
f, as in fan; never ends a syllable

fields.Name: ມ ແມວ
fields.Sound:
ແມວ · “cat”low class
m, as in me; at the end of a syllable: m

fields.Name: ຢ ຢາ
fields.Sound:
ຢາ · “medicine”middle class
y, as in yes; never ends a syllable

fields.Name: ຣ ຣົຖ
fields.Sound:
ຣົຖ · “car (now spelt ລົດ)”low class
r, though most speakers say it as l; re-added for foreign names (ເອີຣົບ "Europe"); at the end of a syllable: n, rarely
fields.Example: ຣົຖlot˧car (now spelt ລົດ)

fields.Name: ລ ລີງ
fields.Sound:
ລີງ · “monkey”low class
l, as in look; never ends a syllable

fields.Name: ວ ວີ
fields.Sound:
ວີ · “fan”low class
v or w — a sound between the two; at the end of a syllable: o (a w glide)

fields.Name: ຫ ຫ່ານ
fields.Sound:
ຫ່ານ · “goose”high class
h, as in hat; silent before ງ ຍ ນ ມ ລ ວ, where it makes them high class; never ends a syllable

fields.Name: ອ ໂອ
fields.Sound:
ໂອ · “bowl”middle class
no sound of its own: the carrier a vowel is written on at the start of a word

fields.Name: ຮ ເຮືອນ
fields.Sound:
ເຮືອນ · “house”low class
h, as in hat; never ends a syllable

fields.Name: ເຫງົາ
fields.Sound: ng · ຫ + ງ: ng said in the HIGH class (the ຫ is silent)high class

fields.Name: ຫຍ້າ
fields.Sound: ny · ຫ + ຍ: ny said in the HIGH class (the ຫ is silent)high class

fields.Name: ໜູ
fields.Sound: n · ຫ + ນ: n said in the HIGH class (the ຫ is silent)high class

fields.Name: ໝາ
fields.Sound: m · ຫ + ມ: m said in the HIGH class (the ຫ is silent)high class

fields.Name: ຫຼັງ
fields.Sound: l · ຫ + ລ: l said in the HIGH class (the ຫ is silent)high class

fields.Name: ແຫວນ
fields.Sound: v or w · ຫ + ວ: v or w said in the HIGH class (the ຫ is silent)high class

fields.Name: ສະຫຼະອະ
fields.Sound: a · short a, as in cut, ending in a catch of the breath

fields.Name: ໄມ້ກັນ
fields.Sound: a · short a INSIDE a syllable — ◌ະ's form when a consonant follows

fields.Name: ສະຫຼະອາ
fields.Sound: aa · long a, as in father

fields.Name: ສະຫຼະອິ
fields.Sound: i · short i, as in bit

fields.Name: ສະຫຼະອີ
fields.Sound: ii · long i, as in see

fields.Name: ສະຫຼະອຶ
fields.Sound: ʉ · short ʉ: an oo said with the lips spread, not rounded

fields.Name: ສະຫຼະອື
fields.Sound: ʉʉ · long ʉʉ: an oo said with the lips spread, held

fields.Name: ສະຫຼະອຸ
fields.Sound: u · short u, as in put

fields.Name: ສະຫຼະອູ
fields.Sound: uu · long u, as in food

fields.Name: ສະຫຼະເອະ
fields.Sound: e · short e, as in pet, ending in a catch of the breath; inside a syllable it is written ເ◌ັ◌ (ເດັກ "child")

fields.Name: ສະຫຼະເອ
fields.Sound: ee · long e, as in they without the y

fields.Name: ສະຫຼະແອະ
fields.Sound: ɛ · short ɛ, the a of cat said briefly

fields.Name: ສະຫຼະແອ
fields.Sound: ɛɛ · long ɛɛ, the a of cat held

fields.Name: ສະຫຼະໂອະ
fields.Sound: o · short o, as in a clipped go, ending in a catch of the breath

fields.Name: ໄມ້ກົງ
fields.Sound: o · short o INSIDE a syllable — ໂ◌ະ's form when a consonant follows

fields.Name: ສະຫຼະໂອ
fields.Sound: oo · long o, as in go without the w

fields.Name: ສະຫຼະເອາະ
fields.Sound: ɔ · short ɔ, as in the British hot

fields.Name: ນິກຄະຫິດ
fields.Sound: ɔɔ · long ɔɔ, as in law, at the END of a syllable; inside one it is written ◌ອ◌ (ຈອກ "glass")
fields.Example: ຂໍkhɔɔ˩˧to ask for

fields.Name: ສະຫຼະເອິ
fields.Sound: ə · short ə, the e of the, said briefly

fields.Name: ສະຫຼະເອີ
fields.Sound: əə · long əə, as in her without the r
fields.Example: ເປີດpəət˧˩to open

fields.Name: ສະຫຼະເອຍ
fields.Sound: ia · ia, as in the British near; inside a syllable it is written ◌ຽ◌, the sign called ວິລາມ (ຮຽນ "to study")

fields.Name: ສະຫຼະເອືອ
fields.Sound: ʉa · ʉa: the spread-lipped ʉʉ gliding to a

fields.Name: ສະຫຼະອົວ
fields.Sound: ua · ua, as in the British poor; inside a syllable it is written ◌ວ◌

fields.Name: ໄມ້ມາຍ
fields.Sound: ai · ai, as in Thai — written ໄ in most words

fields.Name: ໄມ້ມ້ວນ
fields.Sound: ai · ai, as in Thai — the second spelling, ໃ, used in fewer words

fields.Name: ສະຫຼະເອົາ
fields.Sound: ao · ao, as in cow

fields.Name: ສະຫຼະອຳ
fields.Sound: am · am, as in the British hum

fields.Name: ໄມ້ເອກ
fields.Sound: mai ek · tone mark 1: MID tone, whatever the consonant's class

fields.Name: ໄມ້ໂທ
fields.Sound: mai tho · tone mark 2: LOW FALLING tone on a high-class consonant, HIGH FALLING on a middle- or low-class one
fields.Example: ບ້ານbaan˥˨village; home

fields.Name: ອ໊ອດແອ໊ດ
fields.Sound: mai ti · tone mark 3, rare: HIGH tone
fields.Example: ອ໊ອດແອ໊ດɔɔt˧˥ ɛɛt˧˥creak, squeak

fields.Name: ລູກເຕົ໋າ
fields.Sound: mai catawa · tone mark 4, rare: RISING tone
fields.Example: ລູກເຕົ໋າluuk˥˨ tao˩˧dice

fields.Name: ໄຟລ໌
fields.Sound: the silencer: the letter under it is not said — met in loanwords and names

fields.Name: ໄວໆ
fields.Sound: the repeat mark: say the word before it twice

fields.Name: ອັກສອນສູງ
fields.Sound: HIGH class, ຂ ສ ຖ ຜ ຝ ຫ and the six ligatures: with no tone mark, a long vowel or a syllable ending in m, n, ng, w or y is RISING; a long vowel ending in p, t or k is LOW FALLING; a short vowel is HIGH. The tone marks override these: ◌່ makes a syllable MID, and ◌້ makes it LOW FALLING after a high-class consonant and HIGH FALLING after any other. Dialects differ, and the level decks show each word's Vientiane tones as Wiktionary records them.

fields.Name: ອັກສອນກາງ
fields.Sound: MIDDLE class, ກ ຈ ດ ຕ ບ ປ ຢ ອ: with no tone mark, a long vowel or a syllable ending in m, n, ng, w or y is LOW RISING; a long vowel ending in p, t or k is LOW FALLING; a short vowel is HIGH. The tone marks override these: ◌່ makes a syllable MID, and ◌້ makes it LOW FALLING after a high-class consonant and HIGH FALLING after any other. Dialects differ, and the level decks show each word's Vientiane tones as Wiktionary records them.

fields.Name: ອັກສອນຕ່ຳ
fields.Sound: LOW class, ຄ ງ ຊ ຍ ທ ນ ພ ຟ ມ ຣ ລ ວ ຮ: with no tone mark, a long vowel or a syllable ending in m, n, ng, w or y is HIGH; a long vowel ending in p, t or k is HIGH FALLING; a short vowel is MID. The tone marks override these: ◌່ makes a syllable MID, and ◌້ makes it LOW FALLING after a high-class consonant and HIGH FALLING after any other. Dialects differ, and the level decks show each word's Vientiane tones as Wiktionary records them.
fields.Example: ຄວາຍkhuai˧˥water buffalo

fields.Name: ສູນ
fields.Sound: 0 · the digit 0, said suun˩˧

fields.Sound: 1 · the digit 1, said nʉng˧

fields.Name: ສອງ
fields.Sound: 2 · the digit 2, said sɔɔng˩˧

fields.Name: ສາມ
fields.Sound: 3 · the digit 3, said saam˩˧

fields.Name: ສີ່
fields.Sound: 4 · the digit 4, said sii˧

fields.Name: ຫ້າ
fields.Sound: 5 · the digit 5, said haa˧˩

fields.Name: ຫົກ
fields.Sound: 6 · the digit 6, said hok˧˥

fields.Name: ເຈັດ
fields.Sound: 7 · the digit 7, said chet˧˥

fields.Name: ແປດ
fields.Sound: 8 · the digit 8, said pɛɛt˧˩

fields.Name: ເກົ້າ
fields.Sound: 9 · the digit 9, said kao˥˨
